title: maint.event.v1{kind=backup_rotate_key}
description: Phase 8 §8.1 / §8.3 / §8.13.6 — operator triggers backup encryption-key rotation. `target` is the key scope: 'verify' (per-dump verify keypair) or 'dr' (long-term DR-class recipients). The operator runbook at docs/guides/backup_key_compromise_runbook.md (Phase 8.13.6) documents the three rotation scenarios. Consumer: maint.backup.v1 (lands in §8.3).

scope.description: 'verify' rotates the per-dump verify keypair (low blast radius); 'dr' rotates the long-term DR-class recipients per §8.13.6 doctrine.

add_recipient.description: Optional public key (age recipient) to add when scope='dr'.

reason.description: Free-text justification (compromise scenario, scheduled rotation, etc.).
